before:
`flask.sessions.SessionInterface.get_expiration_time` returns a naive UTC
datetime built from `datetime.utcnow`, or `None` when the session is not
permanent.
after:
`flask.sessions.SessionInterface.get_expiration_time` returns a timezone-aware
UTC datetime built from `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`, or `None` when the
session is not permanent.
